dial.summary: Oct PCE inflation and Q3 GDP second estimate release today (Nov 25) on thin pre-Thanksgiving liquidity — DXY eased to 103.99 (from 104.29) but BTC pulled back to ~$59.5K and TOTAL market cap slipped to ~$2.04T, while BTC.D firmed to ~58.5%; macro fundamentals remain intact (M2 at $103.9T, real yields at 2.79% and declining, Fed balance sheet flat at $6.74T) and perp funding at 0.0024% near zero — the low-funding, high-dominance structure is consistent with accumulation ahead of the Dec 9 FOMC decision, though TOTAL's 30-day decline from $2.6T warrants monitoring.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: StreetStats 4-economy basket at $103.88T as of November 23, 2026 (Nov 24 Substack corroborates); September 2026 G4 confirmed data is the base; US M2 component $23.41T in Sep (+5.7% YoY); 3-month basket change +1.55% in dollar terms (+0.82% at constant FX); 4-week trend UP; no YoY contraction signal; status supportive (4-week trend up); next G4 confirmation when October aggregates publish.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: October 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 55.5% (released November 2, above consensus 54.6%), up from September's 54.5%; 4-week trend UP (Sep 54.5 → Oct 55.5, +1.0pp); Production sub-index 59.0 (highest since Nov 2021), New Orders 55.5; status supportive (above 50 and rising, 10th consecutive expansion month); November 2026 data not released — scheduled December 1, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET; consensus ~55.0.

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY eased to 103.99 on November 25, 2026 (Investing.com Nov 25 close, day range 103.81–103.99) as the dollar pulled back ahead of/following Oct PCE and Q3 GDP second estimate; piqmarkets.com put DXY near 103.85 ahead of the data, wellstrack showed 103.91 intraday; 4-week trend UP — from ~101.7 on October 23 to 103.99 on November 25, net +2.3 points (+2.3%), well above the 0.5% flat threshold; status headwind (ICE DXY 103.99 is above 100 threshold); DXY eased from Nov 24's 104.29 on thinner pre-Thanksgiving trading.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield at ~2.79% as of November 24–25, 2026 (businessquant.com tracker shows 2.79% on Nov 24; Yahoo Finance notes 10-year TIPS paying 2.77% above inflation on Nov 20; Nov 19 TIPS auction cleared at 2.903%, secondary yields settled lower as 10yr nominal fell to ~4.92%); 4-week comparison: Oct 23 ~2.90% → Nov 25 ~2.79% = -11bps, exceeds 5bps flat threshold → trend DOWN; status supportive (falling trend, per scoring rules); next key catalyst is Oct PCE deflator released Nov 25 and Dec 9 FOMC decision.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: 2s10s spread ~25bps as of November 24–25, 2026 (MacroMicro T10Y2Y series: 0.25% on Nov 24, prior 0.26%; Recessionpulse: 0.29 on Nov 24; official Nov 20 Treasury par yield curve: 10yr 4.92%, 2yr 4.63% = 29bps); 4-week comparison: Oct 23 estimate ~+40bps → Nov 25 ~+25bps = flattened ~15bps, exceeds 5bps flat threshold → trend DOWN (flattening); curve remains positive (not inverted), well above -50bps headwind threshold; status neutral.

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL at $6,741,452M ($6.74T) as of November 18, 2026 per Federal Reserve H.4.1 (Nov 11: $6,758,867M; Nov 4: $6,748,145M; Oct 28: $6,745,635M); 4-week comparison: Oct 28 $6,745,635M → Nov 18 $6,741,452M = -$4.2B = -0.06%, well within flat threshold; next H.4.1 release November 27, 2026 (covering Nov 25 Wednesday — will capture Nov 25 balance); status supportive (QT effectively paused, balance sheet stable); composition: Treasuries ~$4,587B, MBS ~$1,884B, other ~$289B (Nov 11).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: CoinGlass OI-weighted BTC funding rate at ~0.0024% per 8h as of November 24–25, 2026 (CoinGlass BTC page: 0.0024%; Substack corroboration at ~0.0018%; 30-day settled averages per exchange: OKX +0.0051%, Bybit +0.0053%, MEXC +0.0059%; negative rates briefly appeared Nov 16 across 5 exchanges); rates dipped from prior run's 0.0038% but remain near zero; 30-day trend FLAT (consistently below 0.01%); status supportive (0.0024% far below 0.04% headwind threshold); BTC pulled back to ~$59.5K on Nov 25 from $63.4K on Nov 24.

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Total crypto market cap ~$2.04T on November 25, 2026 (CoinMarketCap: $2.04T, BTC dominance 58.55%, BTC $59,525; down 2.42% on the day); stablecoin supply ~$281B (DefiLlama proxy); derived dominance ~13.8% ($281B/$2.04T); 30-day trend UP — from ~10.7% on October 23 (total market ~$2.6T) to ~13.8% now; status neutral (stablecoin dominance rising on 30-day basis but total market cap declined from ~$2.6T → ~$2.04T — headwind requires BOTH rising simultaneously, not met); market cap pullback on thin pre-Thanksgiving volume; next read after Dec 1 ISM and Dec 9 FOMC.

upcoming.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (November 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases November 2026 Manufacturing PMI at 10:00 AM ET (first business day of December); October reading was 55.5 (10th consecutive expansion month); a continuation above 55 would reinforce the late-cycle expansion narrative heading into the December 9 FOMC meeting; Prices Paid sub-index closely watched given elevated input cost pressures in October.

upcoming.title: JOLTS Job Openings (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases October 2026 JOLTS at 10:00 AM ET; a print above 8M openings would reinforce the tight labor market narrative supporting the December 9 hike case; the quits rate is a leading indicator of wage growth; released 3 days before the November NFP (December 4).

upcoming.title: ADP Private Employment (November 2026)
upcoming.note: ADP releases November 2026 National Employment Report at 8:15 AM ET; private sector payroll estimate published 2 days before the official BLS NFP (December 4); a print above 200K would align with the strong labor market narrative supporting further Fed tightening ahead of the December 9 FOMC decision.

upcoming.title: ISM Services PMI (November 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases November 2026 Non-Manufacturing (Services) PMI at 10:00 AM ET (3rd business day of December); services sector activity closely watched given the Fed's focus on services inflation; a reading above 55 would reinforce the tight labor/services backdrop heading into the December 9 FOMC meeting; released one day before November NFP.
